svg.title: Optional local password-hashing API
svg.desc: The separate ASP.NET Core Minimal API accepts loopback peer and Host only, caps request bodies, redirects HTTP to HTTPS, and applies process-wide rate limiting. Hash and verify have a two-operation concurrency limit. The four routes call Core hashing and inspection without vault operations. Invalid verification is a successful false result, and educational hash creation is rejected. No local-caller authentication is implemented.

g.text: Read arrows in order. SECRET = plaintext; KEY = encryption key; cylinders = stored data.
